titulo: Adjectives and possessives: Dialogue and reading

aula.objetivo: Make the adjective and the possessive agree with the noun in gender and number, using the table of endings.

blocos.titulo: Stress on the ending or on the stem (a trap nobody warns you about)
blocos.explicacao: Stress on the ending or on the stem (a trap nobody warns you about). Here is a trap that is almost never explained clearly: Russian adjectives come in two kinds. In some, the stress sits on the ending in every form: -О́Й in the masculine, -А́Я in the feminine, -О́Е in the neuter. In others, the stress stays on the stem. There is no fixed rule. You have to listen and memorise. What to do? Do not try to guess. Copy the form from the table. With time, your ear takes over.

blocos.titulo: First sentences with «это» and adjective traps
blocos.explicacao: First complete sentences: ЭТО. One word, one world: э́то (EH-tah — "this is"). It never changes, it agrees with nothing, and it solves the present tense of the verb «to be», which in Russian simply does not appear. Your first dialogue in Russian: — Что э́то? (Shtoh EH-tah? — What is this?) — Э́то кни́га. (EH-tah KNEE-gah. — It is a book.) — Кака́я кни́га? (kah-KAH-yah KNEE-gah? — Which book?) — Но́вая. (NOH-vah-yah. — The new one.) And full sentences, with everything you have learned: The question "which?" also agrees: како́й? (masc.), ка́кая? (fem.), како́е? (neuter), каки́е? (plural). — Како́й дом? — Но́вый. (Which house? — The new one.) — Кака́я кни́га? — Но́вая. (Which book? — The new one.) — Како́е пи́во? — Холо́дное. (Which beer? — The cold one.) Classic traps (announced in advance, so you do not fall into them). ⚠ Mistake 1 — choosing the ending by the thing, not by the noun. English never asks you to do this. "The new house" → ❌ нова́я дом. To a Russian, "нова́я дом" sounds as wrong as "a new houses" sounds to you. ✅ но́вый дом — because дом is masculine in Russian. And "the new book"? Книга is feminine: ✅ но́вая кни́га. The ending of the adjective follows the gender of the Russian noun. ⚠ Mistake 2 — touching the root. ❌ "новова́я". The scissors cut exactly two letters. The root is untouchable. ⚠ Mistake 3 — forgetting that -мя is neuter. ❌ но́вый вре́мя → ✅ но́вое вре́мя (вре́мя is neuter). ⚠ Mistake 4 — mixing up the синий family. ❌ си́ная мо́ре → ✅ си́нее мо́ре (мо́ре is neuter; and the neuter of синий is -ЕЕ). ❌ си́ная кни́га → ✅ си́няя кни́га (синий has the feminine -ЯЯ, not -АЯ). ⚠ Mistake 5 — applying -ЯЯ to adjectives with a root in к, ш, г, х. ❌ ру́сскяя → ✅ ру́сская (the root РУССК- ends in к; -ИЙ is a spelling one, the feminine is -АЯ). ❌ хоро́шяя → ✅ хоро́шая (the root ХОРОШ- ends in ш; -ИЙ is a spelling one, the feminine is -АЯ). ⚠ Mistake 6 — looking for the articles. "A new house" and "the new house" are, in Russian, the same thing: но́вый дом. The articles have disappeared; the context does their job. Breathe a sigh of relief: the eternal doubt "the or a?" is over; it has moved to agreement, and you now know how to do agreement.

blocos.titulo: Adjective vocabulary and the gender summary table
blocos.explicacao: Adjective vocabulary (memorise the masculine!). Here are 30 adjectives. Memorise them in the masculine form. The other three forms come for free. A curiosity: кра́сный (red) and краси́вый (beautiful) are relatives — for the old Russians, "red" was "beautiful". That is why Red Square is, deep down, the Beautiful Square. blocos.titulo: Чья это сумка? / Whose bag is this?
blocos.contexto: Two colleagues find objects left behind in the room.

linhas.ru: — Это не моя сумка. Это сумка Лены.
linhas.pt: — It is not mine. It is Lena's bag.
linhas.audio: Это не моя сумка. Это сумка Лены.

linhas.pt: — Right. And whose phone is this?
— It is my phone! Thank you!

linhas.ru: — Не за что. А чьи это ключи?
linhas.pt: — You're welcome. And whose keys are these?
linhas.audio: Не за что. А чьи это ключи?

linhas.pt: — They are Anton's keys. He is at home.

blocos.ru: Это мой друг Антон. У него новая квартира. Его квартира небольшая, но красивая. В квартире большие окна и новый стол. Его друзья любят эту квартиру.
blocos.pt: This is my friend Anton. He has a new apartment. His apartment is not big, but it is beautiful. In the apartment there are big windows and a new table. His friends like this apartment.

blocos.enunciado: Describe something of yours with a possessive and two adjectives, for example: «Это моя новая сумка. Она красивая.»
Write 4 sentences with different possessives (мой, твоя, наше, его).
